ننتثر (form VIII)
# نَنْتَثِرُ (nantaṯiru) /nan.ta.θi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
# نَنْتَثِرَ (nantaṯira) /nan.ta.θi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
# نَنْتَثِرْ (nantaṯir) /nan.ta.θir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
